candidates.title: Manage agents, tools and skills at scale with AWS Agent Registry
candidates.summary: AWS Agent Registry is now generally available: a single, searchable, governed catalog for the agents, tools, skills, and custom resources across your organization. This post explains what Registry is and walks through its publishing, curation, and discovery workflows, plus enterprise considerations and what's next.

candidates.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
candidates.summary: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.

candidates.title: How Boomi Scribe streamlines documentation using AWS
candidates.summary: Boomi Scribe is an AI-powered agent on AWS that automatically generates documentation for enterprise integration workflows. Learn how Boomi uses Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, and AWS Lambda to parse integration DAGs, generate detailed documentation, and compare component versions at scale.

candidates.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
candidates.summary: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

candidates.title: How law firm Gilbert + Tobin governs and scales AI with OpenAI
candidates.summary: See how Gilbert + Tobin combines CEO-led commitment, rigorous governance, and human accountability to scale ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across the firm.

candidates.title: Amazon Alexa can now alert you when something new might tempt you to shop
candidates.summary: Amazon is adding a new Alexa-powered feature called “Update Me When” that can send personalized alerts about product launches, tours, books, shows, and other events that could trigger a purchase.
